method.central_fusion: ascending-ID image-only ADF with known attachments; broad intermediate projection deferred with every full-covariance branch retained; broad final mixture retained
method.selection: Every reaching cycle evaluates the complete Gaussian/Bingham-mixture J and one complete gradient; visual centering is only an initial-point proposal. Accepted candidates are checked against the recorded position-error expectation constraint.

board_image_only_fusion.sensitive_density_check: Independent chart/full covariance check at fixed tolerances, then recompute products/evidence from exactly disclosed Gaussian operands to avoid condition-amplified last-bit differences; no tolerance widening.

K_action_physical_diagnostic.source_scope: historical 0f7 and preceding ccb633, not the new representative-following run
K_action_physical_diagnostic.interpretation: Recorded auxiliary equilibrium delta equals same-K recomputation; selected diagnostic displacement directions mostly agree with true-K physical FK. This is not a proof of globally correct K estimation or successful reaching.

limitations: Physical success is evaluated only by the unchanged 6mm simulator reach condition and absence of forbidden collision across the recorded trajectory. Passing numerical identity/full-J constraints or representative-density follow-through does not establish physical success, calibrated uncertainty, or true K accuracy.
The one-step horizon s constraint is distinct from a guarantee on each 20Hz interpolated physical interval; actual reaching-interval increases are independently counted for each case.

Observation updates can change the relative target error at fixed command. The prior 0f7-source combined 11.72s jump is diagnosed separately in a saved direct-camera artifact and is not automatically attributed to this new run.
The board assumes conditional independence of tag corner likelihoods; shared image errors and ordered ADF approximation are explicit. Final broad mixtures remain; no native mode is dropped.
The existing Bingham-derived core forward moments and single-root-pose approximation need not close exactly under an inverse query; measured residuals are disclosed without cosmetic recentering.
Only selected latest captures are fused; every acquired capture and skipped index is archived. IMU is attached to link_3 in these runs.
Raw detector visibility is image evidence. Physical corner/FK/true-K evaluations are validation only and were not inference/control inputs.
Absolute body accuracy and covariance coverage are measured separately; coverage counts are descriptive, not a calibration guarantee.

representative_refinement_correction.changed_density: Always attempt the already configured bounded score/Armijo refinement, including when the previous representative remains the best fixed start.
representative_refinement_correction.unchanged_density: Exact representative reuse remains permitted when the density ID is unchanged.

historical_visibility_failure.scope: Historical pre-correction diagnosis: the 2372 source could waste time searching despite raw visibility. The new-source strict policy proof is reported separately.

visibility_correction.raw_image_visibility: Fresh real-pixel 15fps detection is kept separate from the slower fused pose-law result.
visibility_correction.raw_visible_hold: During an existing loss-recovery episode, raw image reacquisition brakes and holds; no sweep starts or continues merely because a fresh fused result has not arrived yet. Normal reaching is not held solely because a marker is visible.
visibility_correction.resume: Use a post-stopping valid marker result committed into the active same-K IK plan, preserving every native/goal component.
